name: Agam Arora
description: AI Product Manager. 12+ years shipping product across analytics, gaming, D2C retail, logistics, and AI. Principal Product Manager (AI) at UKG, working on time and labor within workforce management. Previously AVP, AI Products at AIonOS, where he ran a B2B voice AI platform handling 4M+ calls per year at half the market cost-per-minute.

hasOccupation.description: Principal PM working on time and labor within workforce management at UKG.

Led product end-to-end for an enterprise customer experience platform. Two paying enterprise customers in production, multi-million-dollar deal pipeline. Voice AI platform handling 4M+ calls/year at 50% lower cost-per-minute. Three verticals shipped with Fortune 500 engagements. Delivered 15+ AI POCs across RAG, voice, and agentic systems driving $1.5M+ in enterprise deals. MCP-first platform bet.

Led flagship data product ANALYZE. Crossed $1M ARR in 18 months with 35% upsell. Reduced data onboarding from 60 days to 7 via API-first workflows. Improved NPS from 3.6 to 4.7 through platform reliability changes.
Freelance, Canada. Advised startups and VC-backed companies on system design, data analytics, and product marketing. Contributed to $500K+ in funds raised across portfolio.
Built and scaled a gaming studio from zero to $75K ARR. Led a team of 18. Indie Game of the Year 2017.

Manager, New Business Development & Expansion at Aroma Magic / Blossom Kochhar Beauty Products (Jul 2018 to Dec 2019): revamped franchise product, 70% existing-partner conversion plus 4 new partners, +INR 250K contract value per account, 15%+ operational cost reduction via process digitization. Analyst, Analytics & Market Research at Absolutdata Analytics (Apr 2014 to Dec 2015): data analytics and market research supporting multiple successful product launches.
